title: The flying lesson
steps: You have untied the very last one when voices are heard on the field: Ilda is coming with the rest of the pupils! Luckily, you have avoided an accident, although you still cannot tell anyone. {friend} quickly puts the black threads in a pocket so you don't get caught.
Good morning, early risers! Everyone take a broom and follow me to the training field.
I see you all have your brooms. The second-year pupils must remember that their first-year classmates have never used a broom yet, so you must help them.
Look, the first-years carry their brooms like umbrellas! Last year, I crossed the lake on my very first day.

Zarek, silence, and to the line with the rest. I remind you that a broom is lifted with a magic word, *drevo*. You can fly over the water and the hedges, which you could not cross walking. In the first exercise you will have to walk to the end of the jetty, lift the broom with the magic word and fly to the white stone on the other bank.
{Me first, I want to fly right now!|I don't trust a stick that flies.}
Now it's your turn. The water shines ahead, and the white stone waits on the far side. Take a deep breath, hold your broom tight, and let's see what it can do.
